description: What the record covers for an entity, so an empty answer can be told apart: not covered (no source reads it), unknown (covered, nothing checked yet) or covered with nothing on that date. sources: the official feeds that record posts on it or speak for it, its SEC filing (CIK, ticker), Hugging Face authors, Wikidata item and the status dashboard. holds: its public claims by predicate (claims, open, kind: fact, event, list or identifier). freshness: per ingest, when it last added a claim here (last_added), when one was last checked against its source (last_checked) and when reverify.py last confirmed one against Wikidata (last_verified). gaps: what the record does not cover, e.g. 'financials: none; files with the SEC as alphabet'. group: the other records of its company group and how each joined.
name: coverage

page.description: The page on asof.is that states the same answer

sources.description: The feeds and filings that cover the entity

title: Coverage of an entity
